verdict.rationale: cubic runs event-triggered (PR open/push) automatic reviews, codebase scans that deploy many AI agents, and keeps a wiki current via a rolling PR, which shows some always-on/trigger-based agent behavior. However, actual code fixes require a manual 'Fix with cubic' click, auto-approval is opt-in per policy, and there is no documented scheduling mechanism or fully autonomous maintain-and-fix loop without human interaction. Missing for 10: explicit cron/schedule-based agent runs, autonomous (no-click) fixing of issues, and evidence of unattended multi-step maintenance beyond review/wiki updates.
